criteria.requirement: Add Machine.preview_event(model,trigger) for core synchronous FLAT Machine, bound model required. Return current state, ordered candidate source/dest, stable ordinal and condition index/callback descriptor/target (unless false), callback descriptors and runnable="unknown". Do not resolve string callbacks, access callback properties, execute prepare/guards/before/after or change state. Unknown trigger returns no candidates. Preserve internal None/reflexive/wildcard-expanded paths. No hierarchical/parallel/async completeness promise or fabricated allowed=True.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
